en.Situation: In my first coordination role, the sprint board had forty cards in progress and nobody trusted the status column.
en.Task: I was asked to make the board useful before the next steerco, in two weeks.
en.Action: I asked each developer for their real status, updated the board once a day, and published a weekly count of cards by age.
en.Result: Cards older than two weeks dropped from nineteen to four, and the steerco stopped asking for a separate status email.
en.vague: The board was messy and nobody updated it.
en.exaggerated: I fixed the delivery process for the whole department.
en.no_data: After the change the board was more reliable.

zh.Situation: 第一份統籌工作，sprint board 有四十張卡喺 in progress，而冇人信 status 欄。
zh.Task: 我要喺下次 steerco 前令個 board 有用，兩星期內完成。
zh.Action: 我逐個問開發同事真實狀態，每日更新一次 board，再每週公布按卡齡分佈嘅數目。
zh.Result: 超過兩星期嘅卡由十九張減到四張，steerco 唔再要求另外出狀態電郵。
zh.vague: 個 board 好亂，冇人更新。
zh.exaggerated: 我修好咗部門成個交付流程。
zh.no_data: 改完之後 board 可靠啲。

en.Situation: At a bank, the UAT window was booked for the week half the business team was on leave.
en.Task: I noticed it two weeks ahead, and I had to move it without blaming the person who booked it.
en.Action: I checked three alternative weeks, asked the business lead which one worked, and rebooked with the developer's agreement.
en.Result: UAT ran with all eight users present, and sign-off came on the first day of the window.
en.vague: The UAT window was not well planned.
en.exaggerated: I saved the project from a complete schedule slip.
en.no_data: After moving the window, UAT went ahead.

zh.Situation: 喺銀行，UAT 時間窗book咗喺業務團隊一半人放假嗰個星期。
zh.Task: 我兩星期前發現，要搬走但唔怪責負責book嘅同事。
zh.Action: 我查咗三個替代星期，問業務 lead 邊個得，再同開發同事議定後重book。
zh.Result: UAT 八位用戶全部出席，sign-off 喺窗口第一日就到。
zh.vague: UAT 時間窗計劃得唔好。
zh.exaggerated: 我令項目免於完全延期。
zh.no_data: 改期之後 UAT 順利進行。

en.Situation: A vendor delivered two extra reports that were never in the statement of work and then sent an invoice for them.
en.Task: I had to respond without damaging a relationship we needed for the next phase.
en.Action: I compared the invoice lines with the signed statement, sent the two references, and proposed keeping the reports as optional extras.
en.Result: The invoice was corrected the same week, and the reports were added to phase two formally.
en.vague: The vendor billed us for something extra.
en.exaggerated: I caught the vendor trying to overcharge the company.
en.no_data: In the end the invoice was corrected.

zh.Situation: 一個 vendor 多交咗兩份從來唔喺 statement of work 內嘅報表，然後為佢哋開發票。
zh.Task: 我要回應，但唔想破壞下一階段仍然需要嘅關係。
zh.Action: 我把發票項目同已簽 statement 對比，附上兩處引用，再建議把報表當可選額外項目。
zh.Result: 發票同一星期更正，報表正式加入第二階段。
zh.exaggerated: 我抓到 vendor 想多收公司錢。

en.Situation: Four years in, the RAID log had sixty open risks and the go-live checklist was three weeks behind.
en.Task: I had to get the log down to something a steering group could act on before the decision meeting.
en.Action: I grouped risks by likelihood and impact, merged the duplicates, and wrote one line per decision the group needed to make.
en.Result: Sixty risks became eleven decisions, and the group closed nine of them in a single hour.
en.vague: The RAID log was long and nobody read it.
en.exaggerated: I removed every risk from the project.
en.no_data: After the cleanup the group made decisions faster.

zh.Situation: 做咗四年，RAID log 有六十個開啟中風險，go-live checklist 落後三星期。
zh.Task: 我要喺決策會議前把 log 收窄到督導組可以行動嘅程度。
zh.Action: 我按可能性同影響分組，合併重複項，再為每個需要小組決定嘅事寫一行。
zh.Result: 六十個風險變成十一項決定，小組一小時內關掉九項。
zh.exaggerated: 我消除咗項目所有風險。
zh.no_data: 清理之後小組決策快咗。

en.Situation: In my first month, three managers asked for a Friday status update in three different formats.
en.Task: I wanted one page that answered all three, without writing three emails.
en.Action: I asked each manager what they actually did with the update, then built one page with progress, blockers and next dates only.
en.Result: All three accepted the single page, and two of them stopped holding a separate weekly call.
en.vague: Managers wanted updates in different formats.
en.exaggerated: I redesigned reporting for the whole programme.
en.no_data: After the change one page was enough.

zh.Situation: 第一個月，三位經理要星期五狀態更新，但三種格式。
zh.Task: 我想要一頁可以答齊三個，而唔想寫三封電郵。
zh.Action: 我問每位經理實際會用更新做咩，再設計一頁只有進度、阻塞同下個日期。
zh.Result: 三位都接受單頁，其中兩位更取消咗自己每週會議。
zh.vague: 經理要唔同格式嘅更新。
zh.exaggerated: 我重新設計咗整個計劃嘅匯報方式。

en.Situation: During release week the team needed two evenings of OT and nobody had agreed who would cover the Friday.
en.Task: I had to fill the roster in a way people accepted, not just assign the newest person.
en.Action: I asked for constraints first, found two people with childcare on Friday, and rotated the Friday slot between three volunteers.
en.Result: Cover was in place before release week, and the same rotation was used for the next two releases.
en.vague: Release week needed extra hours and the roster was unclear.
en.exaggerated: I eliminated overtime for the team.
en.no_data: In the end cover was arranged and the release went out.

zh.Situation: 發佈週需要兩晚 OT，而星期五邊個 cover 從未議定。
zh.Task: 我要編到大家接受，而唔係直接派畀最新嘅同事。
zh.Action: 我先問每人限制，發現兩位星期五要照顧小朋友，於是喺三位自願者之間輪流星期五。
zh.Result: 發佈週前 cover 已落實，同一輪法之後兩個版本照用。
zh.vague: 發佈週要加班，roster 唔清楚。
zh.exaggerated: 我消除咗團隊所有 OT。
zh.no_data: 最後 cover 安排好，版本出咗。

en.Situation: Five years in, a project reported green for three months and then missed go-live by five weeks.
en.Task: I had to find what the status was hiding, and change the report so it could not hide again.
en.Action: I compared milestone dates with the actual completion dates, then added a second column for the last date each milestone moved.
en.Result: The board could see three milestones had moved twice, and the next project escalated two weeks earlier.
en.vague: The project looked fine and then slipped.
en.exaggerated: I exposed a project that was failing badly.
en.no_data: After the change the board saw problems earlier.

zh.Situation: 做咗五年，一個項目連續三個月報綠燈，然後上線遲咗五星期。
zh.Task: 我要找出 status 遮住咩，並改報表令佢唔可以再遮。
zh.Action: 我比對里程碑計劃日期同實際完成日期，再加一欄記錄每個里程碑最後一次改期日期。
zh.Result: 委員會見到三個里程碑都改過兩次，下一個項目早兩星期升級。
zh.vague: 項目睇落冇事，然後就延期。
zh.exaggerated: 我揭發咗一個嚴重失敗嘅項目。
zh.no_data: 改完之後委員會早啲見到問題。

en.Situation: On a six-month contract, I joined a project whose decisions were in chat threads and nobody could find the last approved one.
en.Task: I was asked to keep a decision log, and I had to make it something people would actually update.
en.Action: I started a table with date, decision, owner and link, and filled the last three weeks from the chat history myself.
en.Result: Two decisions turned out to be contradictory, and the team picked one in ten minutes with the log open.
en.exaggerated: I introduced governance to the whole programme.
en.no_data: After the log existed, decisions were easier to find.

zh.Situation: 做半年合約，我加入一個項目，決定全部散落喺 chat，冇人搵到最後批嘅版本。
zh.Task: 有人叫我維護 decision log，而我要令佢成為大家真會更新嘅嘢。
zh.Action: 我開一張表有日期、決定、負責人同連結，自己由 chat 歷史補齊三星期。
zh.Result: 發現兩個決定互相矛盾，團隊打開 log 十分鐘就揀定一個。
zh.exaggerated: 我為整個計劃引入管治。
zh.no_data: 有 log 之後決定容易搵。

en.Situation: A project manager asked why the testing phase always took twice as long as planned.
en.Task: I had to answer from our own records rather than from an opinion about testers.
en.Action: I pulled the last four projects, compared planned and actual days per phase, and found the delay came from environment availability.
en.Result: The next plan included four environment days, and the testing phase finished inside it.
en.vague: Testing always took longer than planned.
en.exaggerated: I found the single reason all our projects were late.
en.no_data: After the change testing took the planned time.

zh.Situation: 有位項目經理想知點解測試階段每次都花計劃嘅兩倍時間。
zh.Task: 我要用我哋自己嘅紀錄回答，而唔係對測試同事嘅意見。
zh.Action: 我抽最近四個項目，比較各階段計劃同實際日數，發現延誤來自環境可用性。
zh.Result: 下一份計劃預留四日環境時間，測試階段喺範圍內完成。
zh.exaggerated: 我搵出咗所有項目延誤嘅唯一原因。
zh.no_data: 改完之後測試用計劃時間。

en.Situation: Six years in, a go-live was blocked because the security team had not received the evidence pack they needed.
en.Task: I had to unblock it without skipping their review and without blaming either side.
en.Action: I listed the six items they needed, collected four the same afternoon, and got the vendor to send the remaining two by noon.
en.Result: Security signed off the next morning, and the evidence list became a standard part of every go-live checklist.
en.vague: The go-live was blocked by a missing review.
en.exaggerated: I pushed security to approve the release.
en.no_data: In the end the release went ahead.

zh.Situation: 做咗六年，一次上線被卡住，因為安全團隊未收到需要嘅證據包。
zh.Task: 我要解開但唔可以跳過佢哋審核，亦唔想怪任何一方。
zh.Action: 我列出佢哋需要嘅六項，當日下午收齊四項，再叫 vendor 中午前交餘下兩項。
zh.Result: 安全團隊第二朝簽核，證據清單亦成為每次上線 checklist 標準部分。
zh.vague: 上線被一個未完成嘅審核卡住。
zh.exaggerated: 我逼到安全團隊批版本。

en.Situation: In my first job, the programme had eleven projects and no shared view of which were actually on track.
en.Task: I was asked to build the view, and I had to accept that two projects had no reliable dates.
en.Action: I collected the last update from each lead, marked the two with no date as unknown, and sent the page with those two highlighted.
en.Result: The two unknowns were addressed in the next meeting, and the page was reused every fortnight.
en.vague: There was no single view of the projects.
en.exaggerated: I built the programme's entire reporting suite.
en.no_data: After the page existed, people could see the status.

zh.Situation: 第一份工，計劃有十一個項目，但冇一個共用嘅進度視圖。
zh.Task: 有人叫我做呢個視圖，而我要接受其中兩個項目冇可靠日期。
zh.Action: 我向每個 lead 收最近更新，把兩個冇日期嘅標為 unknown，再連標示寄出。
zh.Result: 兩個 unknown 喺下次會議被處理，而該頁每兩星期重用。
zh.vague: 冇一個統一嘅項目視圖。
zh.exaggerated: 我做咗計劃完整嘅匯報套件。
zh.no_data: 有咗嗰頁之後，大家睇到狀態。

en.Situation: Two workstreams needed the same developer in the same week and both leads had already promised their dates to clients.
en.Task: I had to find an option both could live with, without escalating on the same day.
en.Action: I listed what each stream actually needed in that week, found only one day of real overlap, and proposed splitting that day by half.
en.Result: Both dates held, and the split-day arrangement was used again the following month.
en.vague: Two teams needed the same person.
en.exaggerated: I resolved a resourcing conflict that could have stopped the programme.
en.no_data: In the end both teams kept their dates.

zh.Situation: 兩個 workstream 同一星期都要同一位開發同事，而兩位 lead 都已向客戶承諾日期。
zh.Task: 我要搵一個雙方都接受嘅方案，而唔係當日就升級。
zh.Action: 我列出兩邊該星期實際需要咩，發現真正重疊只有一日，於是提出把該日對半分。
zh.Result: 兩個日期都守得住，而對半分嘅安排下個月再用。
zh.exaggerated: 我解決咗一個可能令計劃停頓嘅資源衝突。
